API reference¶

These pages are generated from the docstrings in the Django project.

Project package¶

Django project package for the news application.

Holds settings, the root URL configuration, and the WSGI/ASGI entry points used by the development server and Docker.

Django settings for news_project.

Root URL configuration for the news project.

WSGI config for news_project project.

It exposes the WSGI callable as a module-level variable named application.

For more information on this file, see https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.0/howto/deployment/wsgi/

ASGI config for news_project project.

It exposes the ASGI callable as a module-level variable named application.

For more information on this file, see https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.0/howto/deployment/asgi/

News application¶

News application package.

Provides the models, HTML views, REST API, and approval workflow for the reader, journalist, editor, and publisher roles.

Domain models for users, publishers, articles, and newsletters.

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Model

A news article authored by a journalist, optionally for a publisher.

Independent articles leave publisher empty and are approved by their author. Publisher articles are approved by that publisher’s editors.

class news.models.User(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: AbstractUser

Custom user with a role, subscriptions, and reverse publications.

Reader-only fields:

subscribed_publishers, subscribed_journalists

Journalist-only fields (reverse relations):

articles, newsletters

Non-reader accounts keep subscription relations empty. Non-journalist accounts must not author articles, so those reverse relations stay unused and helper methods return None.
